window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes were thin for US federal, military and local US sources; only verifiable items are included.

stories.headline: Colombian army seizes 1,198 kilos of cocaine from a truck in Meta and ties two arrests to a FARC dissident unit
stories.body: Soldiers from the Fourth Division and Seventh Brigade stopped a tractor-trailer in Puerto Gaitán, Meta, on October 8 and found 1,198 kilos of cocaine. Two people were caught in the act; the government links them to the Amazonas bloc's 39th structure, a dissident faction attributed to alias Iván Mordisco.

stories.headline: Guardia Civil finds nearly 3 tonnes of suspected cocaine and four Kalashnikovs at a rural house in Guadalajara, Spain
stories.body: A joint Guadalajara and Madrid operation turned up about 2,775 kg of a substance that field-tested positive for cocaine at a rural property, plus smaller loads in a hidden-compartment car and a truck trailer. Eight people were detained and seven jailed; officers also took four assault rifles and €28,000 in cash. Raid dates were not given.

stories.headline: Mexican Navy and US Coast Guard intercept a boat 366 nautical miles off Oaxaca carrying about 1.2 tonnes of cocaine
stories.body: A patrol and surveillance flight spotted a blue vessel in the Pacific south of Huatulco, and the Navy seized 46 bundles weighing roughly 1,268 kg. Six people were detained, and the load was taken to Puerto Chiapas. Security chief Omar García Harfuch announced the result.

stories.headline: Costa Rican border police intercept a boat with 103 bundles of apparent cocaine in the Térraba-Sierpe wetland
stories.body: Officers chased the vessel on October 11 between Punta Mala and the Coronado estuary; the crew abandoned it and fled. Authorities say the count is still running and the haul could pass three tonnes, and they are hunting the occupants.

stories.headline: Dominican drug agents seize 228 packages of suspected cocaine at a Santo Domingo port and Punta Cana airport
stories.body: At Don Diego port, 203 packages were found in a false floor of a trailer bound for Puerto Rico after a ten-hour search, and one man was detained. At Punta Cana, 25 packages in a suitcase headed for Paris led to the arrest of a 34-year-old Dutch citizen. DEA and other agencies supported; weights await forensic analysis.
